description: A kick drum: a sine body with a fast downward pitch sweep and a burst of filtered noise for the beater

params.text: Sets the frequency the body settles to, from 30Hz to 200Hz
Sets how long the body takes to fade, from 0.1 to 0.8 seconds
Sets how far the pitch sweep starts above the settled frequency, reaching seven octaves at its maximum
Sets the level of the noise burst that makes the beater sound
Multiplies the whole drum before a soft clipper, from unity at its minimum to six times at its maximum
Sets how long the pitch sweep takes, from 5ms to 100ms

inputs.text: A rising edge fires the drum, restarting both envelopes and the phase of the body
Raises the body an octave per volt, on top of the frequency knob

outputs.text: The drum, soft-clipped and peaking at ±5V

notes: nothing comes out until a trigger arrives; between hits the module puts each channel to sleep and holds it at 0V.
the lamp lights on each trigger and fades over about a fifth of a second.
the amplitude envelope changes shape with the DECAY knob: below 0.4 seconds it is squared, which is tight and dry, and above 0.6 seconds it is straight, which is boomy.
